_comment: x86Sim Speed 18: optional features of the arm64 device. A device's features.json ({"features": {"id": bool}}) overrides the defaults; boot-a64.sh applies it at boot, tools/launcher (x86sim-aot features, the GUI, the MCP server) edits it. A job is left out only when every feature listing it is off. Boot-critical jobs (MIN set, backboardd, SpringBoard, kbd, FileCoordination, sleepd, usernotificationsd) are never listed. cost_mb: PSS measured on a booted device (Speed 17/18 runs); when = boot (paid at every boot) or use (on demand: paid once the feature is used).

features.title: Wallpaper
features.desc: The live lock and home screen wallpaper. Off by default: a still picture instead.
features.tech: PosterBoard and the MercuryPoster extension (the live lock and home wallpaper). Off: SpringBoard shows its last saved wallpaper snapshot (static; black on a new device).

features.title: Search
features.desc: Swipe down to search. Off: search shows nothing.
features.tech: The Spotlight UI process (home screen Search pill, pull-down search), its index (searchd, corespotlightservice; shared with Files, whose Recents needs it) and the query parser's model (assistant_cdmd, shared with Siri). Off: search shows nothing.

features.title: Keyboard
features.desc: The on-screen keyboard. Off: you can't type in apps.
features.tech: InputUI (the on-screen keyboard service) and assistantd (dictation availability, shared with Siri). Off: text fields get no keyboard.

features.title: Siri
features.tech: Campo (the Siri UI angel) and assistantd. Off: the Siri app does nothing.

features.title: Maps
features.desc: Off: Maps can't show maps or search.
features.tech: geod, navd and mapssyncd (GeoServices, navigation, Maps' synced places). Off: Maps cannot load its map or search.

features.title: Photos
features.desc: Off: Photos can't open your library.
features.tech: assetsd (the photo library) and its helpers. Off: Photos cannot open its library.

features.title: Files
features.tech: fileproviderd, the sim2host stand-in and DesktopServicesHelper. Off: Files shows only Recents.

features.title: Wallet
features.tech: financed (FinanceKit's Core Data store, served over XPC) and passd (passes); both start at boot through their launch events. Off: Wallet stops on FinanceKit's 'Could not create CoreDataStore' trap.

features.title: Health
features.desc: Only runs while Health is open.
features.tech: healthd, healthappd and finhealthd, started on demand when Health opens.

features.title: Widgets
features.desc: Home screen widgets. Off by default, they use a lot of memory.
features.tech: chronod, WidgetRenderer and the widget extensions (home screen widgets). Not on by default: about 750 MB more.
